boxes.reason: D3D on vcr-kmd is supervised-only: Rainbow Six is a Direct3D title, and the experimental Voodoo 5 6000 kernel driver may not run one in an unattended sweep.
Windows 7 runs the GTX 1650 on the Standard VGA stub, and no 3D driver exists for this OS, so the D3D title cannot render there.
An operator gate override says 'not wanted on .243' (scripts/gamegate/overrides.txt).

summary: 7 boxes were proven together in one Rainbow Six adversarial game: .123 hosting, plus .110 .133 .143 .171 .184 .240. The verifier re-checked this independently. A fresh netstat on .123 showed 6 of 6 clients ESTABLISHED on :2346, and fresh frames from all 7 boxes showed the 3D action phase (Airport, Adversarial, Double Bluff, Blue and Gold teams). .124 is BLOCKED (D3D on vcr-kmd is supervised-only). .186 and .243 are NA. The game was closed gracefully everywhere, PROCLIST shows no rainbowsix.exe left, and every box's foreground is back on the desktop.
issues: lanparty.py check cannot name players for this title (no query): the roster and packet columns are empty. The witnesses were the host's lobby list and its netstat.
The task's kill syntax 'kill --game RainbowSix' is rejected by lanparty.py. The working form is 'kill RainbowSix'.
